display.purpose: Brand, List titles, screen headings. Helvetica with WenKai for Chinese.

stem.purpose: Question stems, options, answer lines, word cards — content read as a test.

body.purpose: UI copy, hints, settings prose, buttons; Helvetica with LXGW WenKai as the CJK branch.

label.purpose: Column labels, field labels, running heads.

numeral.purpose: Every count and page number; never proportional, LXGW WenKai closes the stack for Chinese in a count line.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The single sheet floating on the desk; nothing inside the sheet casts a shadow.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: The verdict stamp landing: scale 1.28 → 1 with a −3° settle.

motion.name: rule-grow
motion.purpose: Progress rule width, the only other transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The confirming action inside a screen: 提交, 下一题, 保存设置, 返回队列. Ink fill; red is reserved for the cover action and state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 50px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #191a17; color: #fbf8f1; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #000; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Cover Seal Button
components.description: The only red fill in the app: 开始背诵 on the queue cover.
components.css: .ds-btn-cover { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 50px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #b02c20; color: #fbf8f1; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-cover:hover { background: #8f2318; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action in a page foot or settings panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid #c2bdac; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #4f524a; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { border-color: #191a17; color: #191a17; }

components.name: Seal Index Item
components.description: One of 29 punched holes in the page margin; the current List wears the red ring.
components.css: .ds-seal-item { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 1px 6px; line-height: 1.2; color: #5d6057; text-decoration: none; } .ds-seal-hole { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ded9ca; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(42,40,32,.3); } .ds-seal-no { font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, "LXGW WenKai", monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-seal-item.is-next { color: #b02c20; } .ds-seal-item.is-next::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -4px -7px; border: 1.5px solid #b02c20; border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(-8deg); }

components.name: Contents Row
components.description: Queue order in the table of contents: number, title, pending, first-wrong, status.
components.css: .ds-toc-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 54px minmax(0,1fr) 62px 62px 96px; gap: 14px; align-items: baseline; width: 100%; padding: 11px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px dotted #c2bdac; background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toc-row.is-next { border-bottom: 1px solid #191a17; } .ds-toc-no { font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #5d6057; } .ds-toc-title { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", serif; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #191a17; } .ds-toc-num { font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; text-align: right; } .ds-toc-status { justify-self: end; padding: 1px 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", sans-serif; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #b02c20; }

components.name: Answer Option
components.description: One exam choice: Helvetica key, Times body, right-gutter mark.
components.css: .ds-option { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0,1fr) 26px; gap: 18px; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 13px 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px dotted #c2bdac; background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option:hover { background: #f1eee3; } .ds-option-key { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #4f524a; } .ds-option-text { font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, "LXGW WenKai", serif; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-option-mark { font-size: 15px; text-align: right; color: #b02c20; }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: Status and round marks: 1px currentColor box, letterspaced, occasionally rotated.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", sans-serif; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #2c5a48; }

components.name: Rule Field
components.description: Settings and answer input: label above, 1px bottom rule, no box.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field > span { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", sans-serif; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #5d6057; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 6px 0 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #191a17; background: transparent; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #191a17; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #b02c20; outline: none; }

components.name: Verdict Line
components.description: Feedback head: stamped verdict, tabular score, grading route.
components.html: 答错0 / 100自动判分
components.css: .ds-verdict { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 18px; } .ds-verdict-word { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", serif; font-size: 21px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #b02c20; } .ds-verdict-score { font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 26px; } .ds-verdict-score span { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #5d6057; } .ds-verdict-via { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, "LXGW WenKai", sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #5d6057; }

narrative.overview: The app is a bound exam booklet lying on a desk: bone paper, ink rules, one red seal, one green correction. Every screen is a single sheet with a sticky page margin that carries the 29-List index as punched holes and numbers; the queue is a cover plus a table of contents, the quiz is a printed page, and grading is a mark in the margin.
keyCharacteristics: One sheet, one sticky seal margin, no cards
Helvetica for chrome, Times New Roman for question content, LXGW WenKai for Chinese
Red means attention, green means cleared — nothing else is colored
Counts always tabular, right-aligned, in the same column
Two motions: the verdict press and the progress rule

rules.name: The One Index Rule
rules.body: The seal margin is the only index of the 29 Lists. A second list of the same data is a regression to the dashboard the redesign removed.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Only the sheet casts a shadow. Inside it, hierarchy comes from 1px rules and spacing; a container with a border on all sides would read as a second sheet.

rules.name: The Content Face Rule
rules.body: Anything the candidate reads as the test — stem, options, answer, word card — is set in Times New Roman; everything that operates the app is Helvetica.

dos: Do keep one red mark per screen as the attention signal.
Do align every count to the same right edge in tabular figures.
Do let headings carry their own weight, with no kicker above them.
Do keep the seal margin sticky and complete on desktop, horizontal on phones.
donts: Don't add cards, rounded corners, gradients, or a hero metric.
Don't set red and green side by side outside a verdict.
Don't use a shadow for hover or selection inside the sheet.
Don't scale type where weight or reversal can carry the hierarchy.
